body: Worker trap (Termal::Opus3, 2026-11-19, on w-b18b11972c44): twice in a row I told a runner the wrong expected test count. I said 9 for a discovery module with 8, and 68 where 67 was right. Both times I added one too many when stacking test additions across successive rounds. Runners rightly flag such a mismatch as a "count discrepancy", which costs a round trip each time. Before sending a GO request, count the tests in the actual file with grep -c '#\[test\]', and take the last green run's total plus exactly the tests added since. Never estimate.
